name: kof95sr
author: seba371375
description:
The King of Fighters '95 Static Recompilation (kof95sr) is a native, source-level port of SNK's legendary
arcade fighting classic for the PlayStation Vita (Title ID: KOF950001).
Instead of traditional full-system emulation, kof95sr statically recompiles 28,000+ Motorola 68000 arcade
assembly entry points ahead-of-time into optimized C routines, executing them directly on the Vita's ARM
Cortex-A9 CPU at locked 60 FPS with zero interpreter overhead.
